comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Novena MRT about 520 m, Toa Payoh MRT about 1,150 m; closer than 173 of 551 similar developments (the same as 13). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest ST. Joseph's Institution Junior about 890 m; more than 493 of 551 similar developments (the same as 48). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 360 m), more than 275 of 551 similar developments (the same as 68); nearest hawker centre Pek Kio Market And Food Centre about 1,370 m; nearest park Toa Payoh Town Park about 890 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Pek Kio Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 6 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 790 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 930 m; The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,610 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 1,930 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,960 m; The Orie, 25 new sales, about 1,990 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 338 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 53 new sales and 827 resales (880 purchases); new sales were 6% of these purchases. Subsales (54) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 827 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 181 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 827 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 855 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−3.3%). Planning-area private resales −6.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
